name: Lightning Arrow
notes:
Proposed numbers: the 3 arrows fan over 30 degrees, and the lightning strikes reach enemies within 60 of the one hit.

In game (hwp_ran_electric_circuit, tested): 3 arrows in a 30 degree fan, through every enemy and back to where they were shot from at their range or a wall; each hit calls lightning on up to 2 other enemies within 60.
summary:
You fire a volley of three arrows in a V that deals Physical and Lightning damage and pierces every enemy in its path. Each enemy it hits calls lightning down on up to 2 other nearby enemies. When the arrow reaches max range or hits a wall, it returns to where you fired it from, hitting everything along the way again.

AoE and single target:
- In a pack: each hit spawns lightning strikes, and the return trip triggers them again, so the arrow covers the pack twice.
- On a boss: the boss takes 2 arrow hits per shot, one going out and one coming back. Fire with the boss between you and a wall for the shortest round trip and the fastest repeat hits.
